5059.body:
"THE CASH WHEEL" is past the halfway point of its run, with about a third of its tickets still unsold. Late in a run, a game is worth a look when prizes outlast tickets. Early on, the prize design matters most. Here, neither the tickets nor the top prizes are running out faster than the other.

Every line of THE CASH WHEEL's prize table below shows today's count, not last month's.

5063.body:
"CA$H IN HAND" can match another game on price and top prize and still pay out very differently. This game is a game with most of its money in small, frequent prizes. Of its unclaimed prize money, most is in wins under $1,000 and the rest is in bigger prizes. Neither kind is better, and each suits different players.

Two of CA$H IN HAND's four top prizes can still be won.
